source_data_policy: No third-party raw participant files were included in the supplied archives; none was retrieved successfully in this revision. No raw-source rerun is claimed.
freshly_recomputed: Wong task-specific contrasts and Welch intervals from peer-reviewed rounded n/mean/SD
two-orientation reversal IUT/Bonferroni plus two-outcome Holm adjustment
paired profile and evidence-table derivations from distributed summary outputs
full JSON-Schema validation and software regression tests
archived_not_raw_rerun: Wong participant bootstrap, clustered interaction, and 99,999 label permutations
Bastani cluster models and 9,999 Webb wild-cluster replicates
Bassner full 452-to-275 preprocessing and participant models
archived_permutation_table_edits: Only terminology/null-scope annotation and Holm adjustment of existing marginal p values were changed. Permutation draws, interaction estimates, and numerical max-statistic values were not regenerated.
